items.title: Bubble card layout
items.precondition: Signed in; open a post with at least one comment
steps: Navigate to post detail or expand comments on feed
Inspect comment rendering in light theme
items.expected: Each comment renders as a rounded bubble with author name inside, body text, optional image, and meta row below (reactions + timestamp).
items.evidence: 2026-08-03: CommentItem.tsx uses .comment-bubble with in-bubble header (displayName + @username), body, image; meta row with ReactionBar + relative time. index.css defines bubble border-radius, shadow, dark variant.

items.title: Bottom composer placement
items.precondition: Signed in; post detail or feed with comments section visible
steps: Confirm primary composer is not at the top
items.expected: Primary CommentComposer sits in bottom border-top strip; only visible when user is signed in and not actively replying.
items.evidence: 2026-08-03: CommentsSection.tsx renders composer in border-t strip after comment list (lines 137–141); hidden when replyTo is set.

items.title: Reply thread rail
items.precondition: Post with at least one reply to a parent comment
steps: Observe reply indent and vertical rail
Confirm inline reply composer appears under parent when replying
items.expected: Replies nest inside .comment-replies-block with left vertical rail (::before line); reply composer slots under parent thread.
items.evidence: 2026-08-03: index.css .comment-replies-block::before vertical rail; CommentsSection wraps replies in .comment-replies-block with .comment-reply-composer for inline reply.

items.title: Compose and send comment
items.precondition: Signed in; post with comments section
steps: Type a comment and submit (Enter or button)
Optionally attach a photo and submit
items.expected: Comment submits via onCommentSubmit; input clears; new comment appears in list; collapsed send icon visible when empty.
items.evidence: 2026-08-03: CommentComposer handleSubmit calls onSubmit, resetForm on success; pill shell with icon-only send when collapsed. Handler wiring unchanged from prior batch.
items.notes: Interactive click not re-run in finalize session; submit path preserved in component code.

items.title: Frontend typecheck and build
steps: Run npm run typecheck in frontend/
Run npm run build in frontend/
items.evidence: 2026-08-03: npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm run build in frontend/ — exit 0.
